backgrounds.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an actual background texture for a 2D top-down pixel-art fantasy auto-battle game, to be drawn UNDER 64x64 chibi sprites. Create ONE finished rectangular map only, no mockup or sprite sheet. Canvas aspect ratio 7:5 landscape (ideally 1400x1000). Camera: directly overhead orthographic, absolutely no horizon, perspective, isometric diamond or sky. Fine crisp hand-placed-looking pixel clusters on a consistent 2px grid at 896x640 game resolution, limited tasteful palette, clean steps, no blur, no antialiasing, no dithering, no photorealism. Palette should harmonize with softly shaded pastel rose / teal / lavender anime pixel characters, with slate-purple shadows. Center 75 percent of the arena is OPEN WALKABLE FLAT GROUND, subdued contrast, sparse detail, no walls/trees/large objects in the middle, so little characters and bright spell effects remain readable. Enrich only the thin outer edges/corners with environmental accents; do not enclose the map in an artificial frame. Entire image filled with usable terrain, no interface, no text, no logos, no characters, no creatures, no icons, no center line, no checkerboard. Organic asymmetrical detail, not a sports field or repeating tiled grid.
Environment: sunlit spring meadow. Desaturated sage, moss and soft grass green ground, scattered tiny grass strokes and a few restrained flowers. At far outer corners a few flat grey stones and low clover clusters, soft warm light from upper left. A beautiful quiet grass battlefield, not a forest, no tall foreground foliage.

icons.prompt: Use case: icon game UI asset. Create ONE profession glyph for a tiny HP-bar job badge in a cozy pastel fantasy pixel-art auto-battler. Square PNG, genuinely transparent background (alpha), isolated centered symbol filling 84% of canvas. Very simple chunky silhouette readable when displayed at 10 to 16 pixels. Think a 16x16 pixel-grid glyph enlarged with nearest neighbor: rigid square pixel staircase edges, broad 2-3 logical pixel strokes, only 3 flat colors: bright warm ivory dominant, muted rose gold, small sage/teal accent. No dark outline, no badge/container/frame/circle, no letters/text, no gradients, no soft shadow, no bloom, no antialiasing, no texture, no ornament, no hairline strokes. Transparent negative space. Most important is immediate recognizable silhouette. Subject: one upright short sword with a broad ivory blade, stout crossguard, short rose-gold handle.
